claims.citation: New York Herald, 26 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Kangaroo (Br), Manning, Liverpool June 9, via
Queenstown 10th, with mdse and 554 passengers, to John G
Dale. June 18, lat 46 19, lon 41 36, passed ship Kenilworth
(Br), from Hamburg for New York; 19th, lat 44 40, lon 46 26,
steamship Edinburg, hence for Liverpool; 21st, lat 43 05, lon
56 50, ship American Congress, from London for New York;
22d, lat 42 09, lon 61 48, a brig rigged steamer bound E.
